prompt:
A highly realistic close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman (early 20s) with fair porcelain skin and soft natural makeup. She has long, straight, silky dark brown hair with soft curtain bangs falling over her forehead. She wears thin black rectangular glasses with subtle gold metal accents on the hinges and bridge. Her eyes are large and expressive with soft brown irises, looking directly at the camera with a gentle, slightly playful expression. She has a soft closed-mouth smile with glossy, natural pink lips and a light flush of pink on her cheeks.

Her right hand is raised near her face in a classic V-sign (peace sign), fingers slightly relaxed, showing delicate fingers with two thin gold rings on the ring and middle fingers. She is wearing a thin black spaghetti-strap top that reveals her bare shoulders and collarbone.

Soft, even indoor lighting creates a gentle glow on her skin with subtle highlights on her cheekbones and the frames of her glasses. Shallow depth of field, smooth skin texture, realistic hair strands, and natural facial proportions. Neutral beige-to-cream background, clean and minimal. Shot in a high-resolution, photorealistic style resembling a professional smartphone selfie or beauty portrait, slightly tilted head pose, intimate and cute aesthetic.

promptZh:
一张高度写实的特写肖像，主角为 年轻东亚女性（20 岁出头），拥有白皙如瓷的皮肤和柔和的自然妆容。她留着一头长直、丝滑的深棕色秀发，柔顺的法式刘海垂在额前。她佩戴着 带有精致金色金属点缀的黑色细框长方形眼镜。她的双眼大而有神，虹膜呈柔和的棕色，正注视着镜头，表情温柔且略带俏皮。她嘴角含笑，嘴唇呈现自然的粉色光泽，脸颊透着淡淡的红晕。

她的右手抬起靠近脸部，摆出 经典的 V 字手势（剪刀手），手指微张，展现出纤细的手指，无名指和中指上戴着两枚细金戒指。她身穿一件黑色细肩带上衣，露出光洁的肩膀和锁骨。

柔和均匀的室内光线在她的皮肤上营造出温润的光泽，颧骨和镜框上带有细腻的高光。浅景深，平滑的皮肤纹理，逼真的发丝，以及自然的脸部比例。背景为中性的米色至奶油色，简洁且极简。以高分辨率、照片级写实的风格拍摄，类似于专业的智能手机自拍或美妆肖像，头部微倾，呈现出亲切可爱的美感。
